_note: SF-AGD-1 'The agendas arm' (Score Finish Step 5 SR-8b, October 3, 2026; re-read on the DRIVEN fixture by PC-F85, October 17, 2026): the TILSIT board (tests/fixtures/playtest_saves/fixture_agd_tilsit.json, regenerated by tools/gen_agd_fixture.py, which now DRIVES six end turns instead of planting a score and a war age - France at war with Prussia, Prussia's field army destroyed, Berlin and Silesia held, POSEN STILL PRUSSIAN, Davout beside it in Silesia; world turn 7, the war six turns old, the stored score the game's own). Loop 1 takes Posen, so the Duchy of Warsaw's formables gate flips to met IN PLAY. Prussia, beaten and robbed of Posen, then offers a status-quo settlement of its own at the turn boundary; the arm REFUSES it (policy decline_from: Prussia - the player's own confirms are never touched) because it is playing for the Duchy. Loop 2 carves the Duchy through the settlement table's OWN clicks - the client's road: the typed opener the war panel sends, the guided demand row (settlement_demand_add create_client), the offered indemnity (PC-F85 re-measured on the driven board at the head of loop 2, world turn 8, stored score 37: the bare carve REJECTs at 12, the carve with 3,000 gold COUNTERs at 42, the carve with 6,000 gold is ACCEPTed at 72 - it read COUNTER 30 / ACCEPT 90 on the planted score of 100), Submit for Review, and the table's own Confirm (confirm_settlement - since PC-F66 a declaration on Prussia opens its OWN war instance, so the table covers Prussia's war alone and seals directly; the old 'Make peace with Prussia only' click, seek_bilateral_peace, belonged to the coalition war_1 the planted fixture folded Prussia into). The Proclamation card fires on ratification. Run with --from-save the fixture, --turns 3, --diplomacy accept.
